description: This bar chart illustrates the perplexity values for two different pruning strategies—“Per-Output” (blue bars) and “Per-Layer” (orange bars)—across various pruning ratios ranging from 10% to 80%, displayed along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents perplexity on a logarithmic scale, spanning from 10^1 to 10^3. Each pruning ratio has two adjacent bars, one blue and one orange, indicating the perplexity for each method at that specific ratio. The perplexity values are approximately 1.0 for both methods at 10%, 1.0 for both methods at 20%, 1.0 for both methods at 30%, 1.0 for both methods at 40%, 1.0 for both methods at 50%, 10.0 for both methods at 60%, 10.0 for both methods at 70%, and 100.0 for both methods at 80%. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each pruning ratio, with the blue bar consistently positioned to the left of the orange bar. The bars are not sorted by height; instead, they are presented in ascending order of pruning ratio from left to right. There is no visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or outlining applied to any of the bars.
